items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Benny Green, may God rest his soul, he called me downtown. I did one thing with him which was called "Tenor Saxophone Shuffle," that was my song.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, just for myself. Nobody ever called me to go downtown. Oh. Benny Green, may God rest his soul, he called me downtown. I did one thing with him which was called "Tenor Saxophone Shuffle," that was my song. But nobody actually really called me to come downtown. That's one thing that really hurt me, but it's all right, things are beginning to work out now.
You mean during the years that you were at the Paradise, you would have enjoyed going downtown on occasion, at least...
